versions.changelog:
Initial release of pokeperps — trade perpetual futures on Pokémon TCG card prices.

- Allows searching Pokémon cards and analyzing real-time price data.
- Simulate trades, open/close leveraged long or short positions, and manage portfolios.
- Supports up to 50x leverage, with no expiry on positions (perpetual contracts).
- Integrated with PokePerps DEX on Solana and requires network access.
- Includes pre-trade validation, PnL calculation, and portfolio monitoring tools.
- Offers both read-only and trade execution modes (via Solana keypair).
- Accessible documentation and API reference for further integration.
